# `lakana index`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:

Usage: `lakana index [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Register and manage package indexes for Python assets.

## `lakana index add`

Usage: `lakana index add [OPTIONS] {name}`

Register package index NAME.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--url` | text | required | https://host/path of the index, without a user name or password. |
| `--credential-secret` | text | none | Name of the secret that holds username and password, per environment. |

## `lakana index list`

Usage: `lakana index list [OPTIONS]`

List package indexes.

## `lakana index show`

Usage: `lakana index show [OPTIONS] {name}`

Show package index NAME.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |

## `lakana index update`

Usage: `lakana index update [OPTIONS] {name}`

Change package index NAME; only the options given change.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--url` | text | none |  |
| `--credential-secret` | text | none |  |
| `--clear` | text, repeatable | none | Clear a field (repeatable). |

## `lakana index remove`

Usage: `lakana index remove [OPTIONS] {name}`

Delete package index NAME.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
